name: dangerously-skip-permissions
headline: One of three wallets running the same BTC 5-minute Up/Down bot. Part of its quoting is reverse-engineered: its passive bids get filled right after Binance spot moves toward that side, and a public rule built on that signature picks out its fills on held-out windows far better than chance. But traded as a strategy, the rule loses money on 2,011 unseen windows once fills are timed correctly; the wallet's edge is speed and queue position. At a 0% rebate tier its own month would be $49,725.
mechanism: Trades only BTC 5-minute windows, buying both outcomes in most windows at a median pair cost of 1.004; 35% maker fills on-chain. Its taker buys roughly break even before rebates (-0.2% held out); its maker fills earn +3.3% (p=0.03). The maker side is spot-reactive: fills come right after a 2-5 s spot move toward the bought side, strongest at 1 s on Binance, gone by 5 s. The three wallets share thousands of transactions, mostly quoting side by side; direct fills against each other are under 0.5% of each wallet's taker volume. Observed taker-rebate tier Obsidian (50% of fees); 30-day PnL at the 0% tier $49,725, Gold $74,081, Diamond $109,262, Obsidian $117,381.

roc.detail: 2549%/month: 30-day PnL $116,255 on peak capital at risk $4,560; counting the on-chain collateral too ($94,887), at least 117%/month

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed in Polygon OrderFilled events; 35% maker fills (95% CI 29%-42%), 20% of USDC

match.detail: spot-reactive maker, Binance spot: stratified AUC 0.591 vs rotation null 0.500 (max 0.517), p=0.005; rule flags 35% of the wallet's decisions at 1.3x the base rate (z=12.0); same on Kraken: stratified AUC 0.581 vs rotation null 0.501 (max 0.515), p=0.005; rule flags 29% of the wallet's decisions at 1.3x the base rate (z=11.9); frozen, on 2,016 unseen windows (100 rotations, so p cannot go below 0.0099): stratified AUC 0.597 vs rotation null 0.501 (max 0.505), p=0.0099; rule flags 40% of the wallet's decisions at 1.3x the base rate (z=48.6); latency taker, Binance: stratified AUC 0.533 vs rotation null 0.510 (max 0.520), p=0.005; rule flags 37% of the wallet's decisions at 1.5x the base rate (z=5.5); directional maker (fair - price): stratified AUC 0.465 vs rotation null 0.498 (max 0.522), p=1.00; rule flags 14% of the wallet's decisions at 1.1x the base rate; Holm over the six families tested leaves the spot-reactive p far below 0.01 (z >= 9)

backtest.detail: with correct fill timing (block-time slack 2 s) 0 of the 128 FIT configurations were profitable (best -6.9%); the best one, frozen (theta 5e-05, delta 0.04, 2 s move, requote 1 s, 2 s latency), on 2,011 unseen resolved windows: rest of the TEST week strict -5.7% (2,705 fills, p(profit)=1.00); the day after as_of strict -8.7% (1,124 fills, p(profit)=1.00); all, first-in-queue -5.3% (4,575 fills, p(profit)=1.00); at the size the tape allows it would lose about $9,305 a month; without the slack (optimistic): strict +2.5% (1,783 fills, p(profit)=0.12); same rule on the standard TEST sample (no slack) strict +6.8% (80 fills, p(profit)=0.23); latency taker on Binance at 20 s spot age (not achievable) -10.5% (85,617 trades, p(profit)=1.00); same taker rule frozen on the unseen windows at >= 2 s -3.8% (684,438 trades, p(profit)=1.00); directional maker strict -12.9% (5,679 fills, p(profit)=1.00); the wallet's own maker fills +3.3%, taker buys -0.2%

replicable.detail: the matched rule shows a profit only with optimistic fill timing (an order credited with trades that may have matched before it existed) and at most 1 s of spot age; timed correctly at a normal connection's 2 s it loses about $9,305 a month at the size the tape allows, nowhere near $50k. The wallet's own month depends on the rebate tier: at 0% it is $49,725

persistence.detail: last 30 days p=1.7e-09; decline vs earlier p=1.00; last 15 vs prior 15 p=0.54; trend p=1.00

reasons: A public spot-reactive quoting rule matches part of its behaviour on held-out windows (a partial match).
Traded as a strategy, the matched rule loses money on 2,011 unseen windows once fills are timed correctly.
Its own profit at a 0% rebate tier is $49,725 a month.
corrections: The match test now uses a rotation null; the earlier 'AUC at chance' came from the broken clock-shift null.
The spot-reactive signature was found by the reviewer and is now a polyrea hypothesis; on Binance spot it meets the full match bar for GoodFallen and x-MoneyForWhiskas.
'Profit relies on cross-wallet self-trading' was overstated: sibling makers fill under 0.5% of each wallet's taker volume.
The market-vs-model Brier figures are now computed in the study files (TEST: market 0.127, Kraken model 0.137, Binance model 0.135).
